task.title: Keep it safe
task.shortdesc: Save a copy of your tree as a file, and keep it somewhere else too.

step.cmd: On the card for your tree, choose .
Choose how to save your tree.

choices.choice: saves your tree as a family tree file.
saves it with any pictures as well.

step.cmd: When Android asks where to put the file, choose a place you will remember, such as Downloads. Then choose Save.

result.p: You now have a copy. Make a new copy after you add a lot. does not send the file for you. To email it, find it in the Files app. Keep a copy off your phone too.
